checklist.item: Does any step create a circularity
checklist.evidence: None is intrinsic. The design comes before the grant, the grant before implementation, and implementation before S and the census. The census depends on S, but S does not depend on the census, provided the expected digest comes only from the decision or receipt (doc61:45-47; contract 9600645:76-78). One residual risk: doc61:80-81 defers runtime comparison to held work, and item 9 (7b1e606:27) says the commit 'compares the reviewed digest'. A digest literal in a census-pinned body would recreate the C-10 fixpoint. See A2-P3-3.

findings.claim: The 7-step order freezes the implemented successor as S (step 4) without requiring the five approved input artifacts at that commit. Item 21 requires them. The health_legal and configuration artifacts have no named path, writer or review.
findings.evidence: Request MD:43-44@19ed1a4 (and JSON:93-94) says 'Freeze implemented successor...' and 'against actual implemented source and real inputs'. Item 21 (7b1e606:99) says S is the 'application/reader and five-input snapshot, with five referenced input artifacts at S'. Doc 61 C-9 (61:38-40@7ea60dc) requires census, decision and publication to share the same S. Packet JSON:1273@d007162 says 'plus real approved inputs as S', so the two documents disagree. None of the 33 paths is an input artifact (configurationVersion and requiredDigest are null in JSON). A census frozen at an input-less successor would be a second dry run, forcing another S, census and disposition.
findings.fix: Amend step 4: freeze the implemented successor S containing the five approved input artifacts at named paths, written by a named owner under a separate input-artifact grant and review, with class-4 decision A as a hard predecessor. Alternatively, label a census at an input-less successor as a correspondence census only, not CF-11 closure.

findings.claim: The order does not fix how the census/decision S relates to the tree that is later qualified and installed. Excluding cad2c4d, plus pending supervisor amendments, guarantees later commits that differ from S.
findings.evidence: MD:22@d007162 excludes cad2c4d with 'no whole-branch composition'. Doc62:94-96@e27fa1b anticipates 'a snapshot built on it'. Doc68:118-124@36debe0 queues a supervisor amendment to the two files. The request's steps 6-7 (MD:45-46@19ed1a4) qualify and install without saying the tree must equal S. Contract 9600645:64 refuses a mixed-head census, and item 21 calls S the 'reviewed application' snapshot. If composition happens after the census, the served tree is not the one the decision embeds, which defeats the census's purpose in effect.
findings.fix: Decide before freezing S. Either compose cad2c4d and the D68 supervisor amendment first, so S is the qualification and release candidate. Or adopt an explicit rule: the qualified and installed tree must be blob-equal to S on every census reader path and the five input paths, checked at qualification and install and recorded in the external receipt.

findings.evidence: MD:75@d007162. The gate's sources are SNAPSHOT_S_CENSUS_PACKET:40@894da89 and contract:82@9600645. Doc 51 (51:38@9a9023e) makes carry-forwards 1-24 'required before any body is drafted': IN/OUT labels (item 3), digest definition (item 9), call inventory (item 12). Scope item 12 (7b1e606:33) already says the final call graph is 'not falsely claimed complete for an unauthored commit'.
findings.fix: Present the class-3 amendment as a clarification of coordinator wording consistent with docs 51 and 61, citing those lines. Make step 1 explicitly carry all 24 carry-forwards and a prospective 25-row census design (projections, selectors, mutation, lock and absence rules for each relation) as the source-grant basis.

findings.claim: Step 1 does not require the prospective design to name the runtime census-digest comparison source. Held bodies could compile the expected digest into a census-pinned reader and recreate the C-10 fixpoint.
findings.evidence: Doc61:80-81@7ea60dc says runtime comparison 'belongs to held work'. Item 9 (7b1e606:27) says the 'Future server/commit compares the reviewed digest'. C-10 (61:45-47) forbids the value living in a reader file the census pins. The census pins exactly the files step 3 writes (supabase commit body, production.ts). findings.claim: The order lacks an explicit source-acceptance gate for the implemented successor, a re-census rule, a place for P and the external receipt, and the supervisor manifest re-pin.
findings.evidence: Request MD:43-46@19ed1a4 goes straight from 'Freeze' and 'Populate/review completed census' to qualification. Contract 9600645:69 says the original source review establishes reader correspondence. Contract 9600645:76-78 and item 21 order the steps as S, then C, then disposition, then decision at P, then external receipt. The supervisor manifest currently pins 935aaf1 (doc68:41@36debe0). History shows multiple REVISION cycles (docs 52-67), so each source repair means a new S and a new census.
findings.fix: Insert the original source acceptance of the successor S, bundled with the census disposition. State that any source change means a new S and re-population. Place P and the external receipt after disposition and before activation, and make a reviewed supervisor manifest re-pin to S a qualification prerequisite.

verdicts.note: Confirmed. Request steps 4-5 (MD:43-44@19ed1a4, JSON:93-94@19ed1a4) freeze the 'implemented successor' without requiring the five inputs at S. Item 21 (7b1e606:99) requires them at S; doc 53 accepted it as 'Strengthened' (53:50). Contract 9600645:75 and doc61 C-9 (61:38-40@7ea60dc) require census, decision and publication to share one S. Packet JSON:1273@d007162 does say 'plus real approved inputs as S', so the request summary and the packet disagree. health_legal and configuration have no path, writer or review: JSON requiredDigest and configurationVersion are null, and none of the 33 scope paths is an input artifact. The 7-step order sequences no class-4 step at all. Adopted as written, it gives a census that cannot close CF-11. P2 is right.

The gap is real, but I downgrade it to P3. No step adopts a mixed tree, and packet decision D (MD:73@d007162) already defers the served-candidate plan until after the accepted census and qualification. The manifest pins application source by commit (source.commit=f581b6b at S) and qualifies a detached checkout of that commit, so qualifying exactly S already works by pinning S in a post-S manifest. cad2c4d's 8 client paths are disjoint from S's diff and from every prospective reader path, so composing it later changes no reader blob. A blob-equality rule on reader and input paths at qualification and install is a precision item for gate D, not a reason to revise the order now.

Partly upheld. The e90d464 omission is mostly cosmetic: doc58:99@202ed1a says '2d2d958 and its receipt replace e90d464 as the accepted currentness source', and the precheck/postcheck blobs ff6cc891/02453231 are identical at e90d464, 2d2d958, 935aaf1 and S. The pre-3e82154 chain (docs 36-47; 7d027e4 REVISION in doc45, repaired by 3e82154) is ancestral and reviewed. The stale labels are real: JSON:17 and :64 say PENDING, and binding:61@e6494ba says sourceAcceptance PENDING, while doc68 is SOURCE ACCEPT WITH LIMITS (9f57058, corrected at 36debe0). Overlay 19ed1a4:16 corrects this without changing bytes.

Confirmed. No reviewer doc requires a completed census before bodies. Doc 51 (51:38@9a9023e) requires only the 24 carry-forwards 'before any body is drafted'. Scope item 12 (7b1e606:33) says the final call graph is 'not falsely claimed complete for an unauthored commit'. The 'circular census-before-body' gate traces to coordinator wording: SNAPSHOT_S packet:40@894da89 ('Complete census/call/privilege/lock design'), contract 9600645:82 (ambiguous) and COORDINATION_STATE:6420@d007162. Packet MD:75 overstates it as 'literally require'.

Upheld. C-10 (61:45-47@7ea60dc) already forbids a digest literal in census-pinned readers. However, item 9 (7b1e606:27) assigns the comparison to 'future server/commit', and doc61:80-81 defers it to held work. The only non-circular comparison source for a runtime that cannot see the census file is still unspecified. Step 1 should name that comparator, and the source review should check it.

The gaps are upheld, but the fix needs correcting. The request (MD:40-46@19ed1a4) has no explicit original source-acceptance gate, no re-census-on-change rule and no manifest re-pin. The manifest pins application f581b6b and database 935aaf1, and a later manifest commit must pin S. But the fix wrongly places 'the external receipt after disposition'. Doc 61 CF-11 (61:74-78) needs the census binding record after C and before the original disposition, as the current 25858ad binding does. The operational receipt that binds P comes after the decision (9600645:78). These are two records and need two placements. See missed A2V-M2.

Confirmed. The 8 OUT rows (readers=[], selectors=[]) pin no bytes. Their exclusion texts are time-relative ('Current Quick Order...', 'current Quick Order consumes no nonce subsystem'), and product_media carries an explicit 'restore before census completion' caveat. Partial@d007162 with f98 substituted back recomputes to 4f6c39ac, and with S to 5fcbe47b (a single occurrence). I checked one candidate: session_active(text,uuid,text) reads only research_private_early_access_sessions (research-private-early-access-sessions.sql:539-568@25858ad), so the nonce exclusion holds against that call. It must still be re-derived at the real S.

Factual. V1 was added at a853479 (sha256 848e3988…, cited by commit in the db4c230 handoff:11), then modified at db4c230 and 51cf986 (sourceReviewUpdates A/B/C rewritten). This came after doc58 C-7 (202ed1a, 2026-10-08 15:17) asked for separate-file addenda. V1 blob 1f7e121 has been unchanged since 51cf986 through e6494ba and 19ed1a4, so binding:64 is true for this turn but omits the lineage. This is records hygiene, adjacent to the lens's scope.

verify.disposition:
Disposition A: the snapshot proposal and partial census are FACTUALLY CORRECT AS PARTIAL. No packet byte revision is required.
- S is 25858ad, tree c5565bcd. Its composition, the cad2c4d exclusion and the 14 candidate hashes all reproduce.
- The partial census (5fcbe47b) and its binding (b6056e18) reproduce.
- Carry the Doc68 acceptance by overlay only (already at 19ed1a4:16). The lineage note is P3.

25858ad is not a viable CF-11 census S, and the packet does not claim it is. Use it as the implementation base and preimage anchor, and treat its partial census as a format dry run. The real S is the implemented, source-accepted successor that also holds the five approved inputs, and all 25 rows, including the 8 exclusions, must be re-derived there.

Order of work: acceptable only with amendment.
- P2-1, required: step 4 must freeze S with the five approved input artifacts at named paths, with the class-4 owner and review sequenced before the freeze.
- P3 items: the stock predicate before step 3; an explicit source acceptance; the census binding record before disposition and the operational receipt after P; M-1 and M-2; the runtime comparator source; re-census on any change; a manifest re-pin; blob-equality at qualification and install.

The order has no circularity and no census waiver. No P0 or P1. Everything is NOT RUN, and nothing here is Samuel's approval.
